rationale: itnet-claude-agentic: pretrain_epochs=60, pretrain_lr=0.001, itnet_k=1, itnet_alpha=0.02, unet_c=16, finetune_epochs=0, finetune_lr=0.0001, train_n=800, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, seed=44, rationale=iter-15 (breast ItNet v1). SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: SEED-NOISE DISCOVERY. Champion config (c16,tn800,ep60,k1,a0.02) at seed42 (iter-12) = 0.8852, at seed43 (iter-14) = 0.8699 -> a 0.0153 swing from SEED ALONE. This DWARFS the sub-0.001 deltas between iter-8/10/12 -> those were NOISE, not signal. The search is seed-noise-limited (~+-0.015 band). (2) FAILURE MODE: single-run hr is unreliable at the plateau; the honest reported number must be a MEAN over seeds. (3) ONE KNOB (from champion iter-12): seed 43 -> 44 (third replicate). All else identical. (4) HYPOTHESIS: seed44 lands within the [0.870, 0.885] band established by seeds 42/43, letting me estimate the plateau MEAN over 3 seeds. FALSIFIER: if seed44 is outside that band, the noise is even wider and more replicates are needed. (5) BUDGET: ep60/tn800 ~1140s, in budget. (6) Loop to iter-20; remaining iters extend the seed-replicate set for a plateau mean+-std.
